s1.desc: a kitchen with pastel cabinets along the walls and a cream fridge

s3.desc: a pale room with a tall arched doorway

spans.notes: Pax at the open fridge holding a juice jug: static f0-9 (10 frames, ECC 0 px), then a fast pull-back f10-15 to the wide kitchen; locked from f16. Both pieces under 21 frames.

spans.view: with the fridge on the left and a long row of cabinets and counters behind him

beats.text: Pax holds a jug of orange juice and pushes the fridge door shut with his flipper
Pax skips off to the right with the jug tucked under his flipper, bouncing on his feet

spans.notes: camera locked f16-41 (ECC on the cabinet band: scale 0.8443 constant vs f13; pixel diff of the top band vs f16 <= 0.03). Pax reaches the right edge and is half cut off f39-41 but never leaves. No overlay.

four short shots, nothing keepable: f42-66 Pax from behind opens a cupboard (static f42-48, push-in f49-55, static f56-66 with only his back at the left edge and the empty shelves); f67-81 Pax behind a counter holding the jug, looking around (15 frames); f82-98 an empty sink with only Pax's side at the left edge (17 frames); f99-116 Pax opens an empty dishwasher, holding the jug up (18 frames).

beats.text: Pax tilts his head and gazes up to one side with a puzzled, worried frown
Pax straightens up and brings a flipper to his chin, gazing off to the side with one brow raised

spans.notes: plain background (ECC: no texture); pixel diff of the top quarter is 0.00 vs f117 for every frame, and Pax's belly line stays at the same height: camera locked. The profile's d1 at f129/130 is a pose change (flipper to chin), not a cut. Pax is cut off at the belly by the bottom edge. No overlay.
Pax walks into an arched doorway from the right (static f146-162, 17 frames), then a fast pull-back f163-166 reveals shelves of mugs in the foreground; locked from f167.

spans.view: with shelves crowded with mugs and cups and a wicker basket of cups in the foreground

beats.text: Pax stands motionless in the arched doorway, staring straight ahead with a blank expression

spans.notes: camera locked f167-188 (ECC on the shelf band vs f167: scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000); f166 is the last frame of the pull-back. 22 frames. No overlay.
insert of a desk piled with mugs, a laptop and a flower vase, with a name label (in-world text, a lead's name), panning right from ~f203; no character in view.

spans.view: with the edge of the arched doorway behind him

beats.text: Pax stands in front of the archway with his flippers held out at his sides, glancing around with a worried frown
Pax flings both flippers up into the air with a worried frown
Pax clutches his head with both flippers, looking around anxiously
Pax throws his flippers out wide with his eyes squeezed shut
Pax drops his flippers and stares toward the right while Polly slides into view at the right edge

spans.notes: camera locked f224-275: pixel diff of the archway band (top 30%, right half) is 0.00 vs f224 on every frame (ECC is unreliable on the soft archway gradient here). A pull-back starts at f276. Polly is only partly in view at the right edge f267-275. No overlay.
pull-back f276-281 as Pax turns to Polly, who holds a clay jug; locked f282-301 (band pixel diff 0.00) but that is only 20 frames: Polly lowers the jug from her beak, smiling, beside Pax.
